verdict.rationale: Logseq has no documented native bulk-edit feature. Bulk work is only implied: a whole-graph export, plus a local HTTP API and plugin API that external scripts or agents could use to change many blocks or pages programmatically. A community user also notes that external AI tools could update the markdown pages in v1, but says this no longer works in the DB version. Missing for 10: a documented native multi-select/bulk edit, move or tag operation; documented batch endpoints in the HTTP/plugin APIs; hands-on evidence of bulk operations working at scale.
